title: Formally audit exact rounded phase state reconstruction
body:
PR1141's exact rounded-grid reconstruction argument now has an independent Lean proof. The seven exported roots establish two-sided three-shear rotation inverses, the nonlinear two-register state inverses, arbitrary-length reconstruction in both directions, and deterministic readout preservation. The model permits arbitrary integer-grid states and arbitrary deterministic rounded-product/chart functions. It explicitly restores the ratio before rebuilding its chart and reuses the same rounded product in inverse shears; half-up rounding need not be odd.

The unchanged source is Ali Romman's PR1141 at `1627bf208f80e490522343590dd52f38b329e238`, retaining all 25 source files, notices and PR1038/PR985/PR479 lineage. This formalizes an existing claim, without introducing a phase algorithm or upgrading the pending source's review status. Source interpretation is reviewed and finitely tested, not a verified Python-to-Lean translation. Analytic error/seed proofs, physical widths, scratch, tape restoration, runtime and complete supplier admission remain outside scope.

Validation passed with CPython 3.12.7: registered ordinary and optimized replay, 12,556 rotation fixtures, 496 chart comparisons, 5,000 arbitrary dirty states, 48 traces / 4,056 steps, four actual prepared-pass inverses, six semantic controls, and Git-free read-only export/eight integrity controls. Fresh Windows Lean 4.34.1 compilation reports only `propext` for all seven roots; four false propositions and a forged axiom report are rejected. A separate Codex agent read the proof/source and independently passed optimized CPython 3.12.14 plus the fresh Lean harness. Python's registered replay checks the formal receipt but does not itself run Lean.

```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rounded-phase-reconstruction
python -I -O -B research/rounded-phase-reconstruction/kernel.py --lean /path/to/lean.exe
```

Started from current main at selection and fast-forwarded before submission to `6bd33bc0b87a01e9c9d8b1c01576f3ddbcaee850`, guidance revision 5. The drawn uniform-transfer alternative was selected after screening existing stock work. Overlap evidence combines the complete 838-open-PR 16:50 UTC and 1,303-Discussion 16:54 UTC snapshots, local main, the newest 100 all-state REST PRs, and an unchanged live PR1141 head. A newer Discussion refresh was rate-limited; this is bounded coverage, not a novelty certificate. The family decision is narrow and stop at this local audit. README/TASK record concrete next proof-interface questions.

New work by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for formalization, implementation, validation, writing and separate-agent review. Apache-2.0. No new kappa, analytic precision claim, complete supplier replay or human/maintainer acceptance is claimed.
